Description: No error

Category: Configuration error of the interface - Modbus_Comm_Load
Description: The module does not support this data transmission rate.
Remedy: Select a valid data transmission rate for the module at the BAUD parameter.

Category: Configuration error of the interface - Modbus_Comm_Load
Description: The module does not support this parity setting.
Remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Parity" at the PARITY parameter.
The following are valid:
None (1)
Even (2)
Odd (3)
Mark (4)
Space (5)
Any (6)

Category: Configuration error of the interface - Modbus_Comm_Load
Description: The module does not support this type of data flow control.
Remedy: Select a valid data flow control for the module at the FLOW_CTRL parameter.

Category: Configuration error of the interface - Modbus_Comm_Load
Description: Invalid value for "Response timeout".
Remedy:
Select a suitable value for "Response timeout" at the RESP_TO parameter.
Valid range of values: 1 to 65535 (ms)

Category: Configuration error of the interface - Modbus_Comm_Load
Description: Negative acknowledgment when reading module
Remedy:
Check the input at the PORT parameter.
You can find more detailed information on error causes in the Send_Config.RDREC.STATUS or Receive_Config.RDREC.STATUS static parameters or RDREC.STATUS and in the description of the SFB RDREC.

Category: Configuration error of the interface - Modbus_Comm_Load
Description: Negative acknowledgment when writing module
Remedy:
Check the input at the PORT parameter.
You can find more detailed information on error causes in the Send_Config.WRREC.STATUS or Receive_Config.WRREC.STATUS static parameters or WRREC.STATUS and in the description of the SFB WRREC.

Category: Configuration error of the interface - Modbus_Comm_Load
Description: Module not available
Remedy: Check the input at the PORT parameter and ensure that the module can be reached.

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Slave
Description: Invalid slave address
Remedy:
Select a suitable slave address at the MB_ADDR parameter.
The following are valid: 1-247 at standard address area;
1-65535 at extended address area
(0 is reserved for Broadcast)

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Slave
Description: Invalid value at MB_HOLD_REG parameter
Remedy: Select a suitable value for the hold register at the MB_HOLD_REG parameter.

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Slave
Description:
Invalid operating mode or broadcast
(MB_ADDR = 0) and MODE parameter ≠ 1
Remedy:
Select the value 1 for MODE in Broadcast mode or
select a different operating mode.

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Slave
Description: The pointer to a MB_HOLD_REG area must be a data block or a bit memory address area.
Remedy: Select a suitable value for the pointer to the MB_HOLD_REG area.

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Slave
Description: Negative acknowledgment when reading module
Remedy:
Check the input at the PORT parameter.
You can find more detailed information on error causes in the static parameters Send_P2P.RDREC.STATUS or Receive_P2P.RDREC.STATUS, and in the description of the SFB RDREC.

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Slave
Description: Negative acknowledgment when writing module
Remedy:
Check the input at the PORT parameter.
You can find more detailed information on error causes in the static parameters Send_P2P.WRREC.STATUS or Receive_P2P.WRREC.STATUS, and in the description of the SFB WRREC.

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Slave
Description: MB_HOLD_REG is not a pointer to a DB or a bit memory area
Remedy: Check the MB_HOLD_REG pointer

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Slave
Description: MB_HOLD_REG is not a pointer of type BOOL or WORD
Remedy: Check the MB_HOLD_REG pointer

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Slave
Description: The area addressed by MB_HOLD_REG is longer than the DB, or the area addressed is too small for the number of data bytes to be read or written.
Remedy: Check the MB_HOLD_REG pointer

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Slave
Description: MB_HOLD_REG points to a write-protected DB
Remedy: Check the MB_HOLD_REG pointer

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Slave
Description: Error during instruction execution. The cause of the error is shown in the STATUS parameter.
Remedy: Determine the value of the SFCSTATUS parameter. Check what this means in the description for SFC51, STATUS parameter.

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Master
Description: Invalid value for MB_DB parameter
Remedy:
The value configured for MB_DB (instance data DB) at the Modbus_Comm_Load instruction is not valid.
Check the interconnection of the Modbus_Comm_Load instruction and its error messages.

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Master
Description: Invalid station address
Remedy:
Select a suitable station address at the MB_ADDR parameter.
The following are valid: 1-247 at standard address area;
1-65535 at extended address area
(0 is reserved for Broadcast)

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Master
Description: Invalid operating mode or broadcast (MB_ADDR = 0) and MODE parameter ≠ 1
Remedy: Select the value 1 for MODE in Broadcast mode or select a different operating mode.

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Master
Description: Invalid data address
Remedy:
Select a suitable value for the data address at the DATA_ADDR parameter.
See description Modbus_Master in the Info system

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Master
Description: Invalid length
Remedy:
Select a suitable data length at the DATA_LEN parameter.
See description Modbus_Master in the Info system

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Master
Description: Invalid value for DATA_PTR
Remedy:
Select a suitable value for the data pointer at the DATA_PTR parameter (M or DB address).
See description Modbus_Master in the Info system

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Master
Description: Interconnection error of the DATA_PTR parameter
Remedy: Check the interconnection of the instruction.

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Master
Description: The area addressed by DATA_PTR is longer than the DB, or the area addressed is too small for the number of data bytes to be read or written.
Remedy: Check the DATA_PTR pointer

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Master
Description: Negative acknowledgment when reading module
Remedy:
Check the input at the PORT parameter.
You can find more detailed information on error causes in the static parameters Send_P2P.RDREC.STATUS or Receive_P2P.RDREC.STATUS, and in the description of the SFB RDREC.

Category: Configuration error - Modbus_Master
Description: Negative acknowledgment when writing module
Remedy:
Check the input at the PORT parameter.
You can find more detailed information on error causes in the static parameters Send_P2P.WRREC.STATUS or Receive_P2P.WRREC.STATUS or Receive_Reset and in the description of the SFB WRREC.

Category: Communication errors - Modbus_Master and Modbus_Slave
Description: The waiting time for XON or CTS = ON has expired.
Remedy: The communication partner has a fault, is too slow or is offline. Check the communication partner or change the parameters, if necessary.

Category: Communication errors - Modbus_Master and Modbus_Slave
Description: "Hardware RTS always ON": Send job canceled due to change from DSR = ON to OFF
Remedy: Check the communication partner. Make sure that DSR is ON for the entire duration of transmission.

Category: Communication errors - Modbus_Master and Modbus_Slave
Description: Frame aborted: Send buffer overflow / send frame too long
Remedy: In the user program call the instruction more often or configure a communication with data flow control.

Category: Communication errors - Modbus_Master and Modbus_Slave
Description: Frame aborted: Parity error
Remedy: Check the connection line of the communication partners, or verify that the same data transmission rate, parity and stop bit number are configured for both devices.

Category: Communication errors - Modbus_Master and Modbus_Slave
Description: Frame aborted: Character frame error
Remedy: Check the settings for start bit, data bits, parity bit, data transmission rate, and stop bit(s).

Category: Communication errors - Modbus_Master and Modbus_Slave
Description: Frame aborted: Character overflow error
Remedy: Check the number of data in the frame of the communication partner.

Category: Communication errors - Modbus_Master and Modbus_Slave
Description: Frame aborted: Maximum frame length reached
Remedy:
Select a shorter frame length at the communication partner.
The following are valid (depending on the module): 1 to 1024/2048/4096 (bytes)

Category: Communication error - Modbus_Master
Description: The slave does not respond within the set time
Remedy: Check the data transmission rate, parity and wiring of the slave.

Category: Communication error - Modbus_Master
Description: The slave does not respond within the time set by Blocked_Proc_Timeout.
Remedy:
Check the setting for Blocked_Proc_Timeout.
Check if the module has been configured with the Modbus_Comm_Load instruction. The module may possibly need to be reconfigured using Modbus_Comm_Load after a pull/plug or after voltage recovery.

Category: Communication error - Modbus_Master
Description: The interface is busy with an ongoing request.
Remedy: Repeat the command later. Make sure that there are no commands still running before you start a new one.

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Slave (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: CRC error
Remedy: Checksum error of the Modbus frame. Check the communication partner.

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Slave (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: The function code is not supported or is not supported for broadcast.
Remedy: Check the communication partner and make sure that a valid function code is sent.

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Slave (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: Invalid length information in the request frame
Remedy: Select a suitable data length at the DATA_LEN parameter.

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Slave (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: Invalid data address in the request frame
Remedy: Select a suitable value for the data address at the DATA_ADDR parameter.

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Slave (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: Invalid data value error in the request frame
Remedy: Check the data value in the request frame of the Modbus master

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Slave (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: The diagnostic value is not supported by the Modbus slave (function code 08)
Remedy: The Modbus slave only supports the diagnostic values 16#0000 and 16#000A.

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Master (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: CRC error
Remedy: Checksum error of the Modbus frame. Check the communication partner.

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Master (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: Response frame from Modbus Slave with the following error message: The function code is not supported.
Remedy: Check the communication partner and make sure that a valid function code is sent.

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Master (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: Response frame from Modbus Slave with the following error message: Invalid length
Remedy: Select a suitable data length.

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Master (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: Response frame from Modbus Slave with the following error message: Invalid data address in the request frame
Remedy: Select a suitable value for the data address at the DATA_ADDR parameter.

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Master (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: Response frame from Modbus Slave with the following error message: Data value error
Remedy: Check the request frame to the Modbus slave.

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Master (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: Response frame from Modbus Slave with the following error message: The diagnostic value is not supported by the Modbus slave
Remedy: The Modbus slave only supports the diagnostic values 16#0000 and 16#000A.

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Master (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: The returned function code does not match the requested function code.
Remedy: Check the response frame and the addressing of the slave.

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Master (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: A slave that was not requested answers
Remedy: Check the response frame of the slave. Check the address settings of the slave.

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Master (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: Error in the response of the slave to a write request.
Remedy: Check the response frame of the slave.

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Master (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: DATA_PTR points to a bit address that is not equal to n * 8
Remedy: Check the DATA_PTR pointer

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Master (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: DATA_PTR is not a pointer to a DB or a bit memory area
Remedy: Check the DATA_PTR pointer

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Master (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: DATA_PTR is not a pointer of type BOOL or WORD
Remedy: Check the DATA_PTR pointer

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Master (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: DATA_PTR points to a write-protected DB
Remedy: Check the DATA_PTR pointer

Category: Protocol error - Modbus_Master (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: Error during call of SFC51
Remedy: Call the Modbus_Master instruction again

Category: Error - Modbus_Slave (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: MB_HOLD_REG points to a bit address that is not equal to n * 8
Remedy: Check the MB_HOLD_REG pointer

Category: Error - Modbus_Slave (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: MB_HOLD_REG is not a pointer to a DB or a bit memory area
Remedy: Check the MB_HOLD_REG pointer

Category: Error - Modbus_Slave (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: MB_HOLD_REG is not a pointer of type BOOL or WORD
Remedy: Check the MB_HOLD_REG pointer

Category: Error - Modbus_Slave (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: The area addressed by MB_HOLD_REG is longer than the DB, or the area addressed is too small for the number of data bytes to be read or written.
Remedy: Check the MB_HOLD_REG pointer

Category: Error - Modbus_Slave (only communication modules that support Modbus)
Description: MB_HOLD_REG points to a write-protected DB
Remedy: Check the MB_HOLD_REG pointer
